name: locus
description: Structured phased decomposition for agentic execution. Injects the Locus dispatcher next to every prompt, enforces the classification line at turn end, and ships the Algorithm as a progressively-disclosed skill.

dataDir.title: Locus data directory
dataDir.description: Where Locus keeps learnings, work artifacts, checkpoints and the activation log. Left unset, the plugin uses its own data directory.

alleleBinary.title: allele binary
alleleBinary.description: Path to the allele binary that serves the delegation MCP. Leave as `allele` to resolve it from PATH.
